purpose: Teach: 殴ら/混沌/露骨/濫用/在留/誘発/解任/権益

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者が殴られた経緯を警察、調査されてますね
lines.en: So in this case, the police are investigating how the victim came to be assaulted, aren't they?
lines.style: Measured and careful, thinking aloud. Slight pause before the question tag. Soft, analytical tone—not confrontational, genuinely seeking clarification.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、混沌とした現場を整理しました
lines.en: The police have worked to establish order from what was a chaotic scene.
lines.style: Direct, professional authority in the voice. Clipped precision on key facts. Even pace, no flourish. A statement of completed work, not defensive.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、露骨な脅迫行為を警察、立件されたんですね
lines.en: And in this case, the police have filed charges for the explicit threats made, haven't they?
lines.style: Gentle follow-up, checking the next piece. Same analytical register—building the picture step by step. Slight lift on the question.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、職権濫用を絶対に防止します
lines.en: The police are committed to preventing any abuse of authority.
lines.style: Firm conviction without hardness. Weight on 'preventing'—not a promise but a principle. Steady eye level. Professional reassurance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、在留資格詐欺の事案を警察、捜査されてますね
lines.en: So the police are also investigating the fraud related to forged residency status in this case, I take it?
lines.style: Continuing the thread methodically. Thoughtful pause before speaking. Soft curiosity, not accusation. Respects the complexity being outlined.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、暴動を誘発する発言を厳重に警戒します
lines.en: The police are vigilant against speech that could incite unrest.
lines.style: Clear seriousness without alarm. Weighted delivery on 'vigilant'—this matters. Steady, controlled pace. Not emotional, but attentive.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、署長解任の手続きを警察、明らかにされましたね
lines.en: And regarding this case, the police have clarified the procedures for the chief's removal, haven't they?
lines.style: Final check in a long chain of questions. Patient and thorough. Quiet certainty in the voice—confirming what's been outlined.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、漁業権益の紛争にも対応します
lines.en: The police are prepared to address disputes over fishing rights as well.
lines.style: Broader statement, slightly warmer than before. A closing note of competence. Small shift toward the personal—still official, but showing availability.
